# Busuu Blog

> > The official blog of Busuu, a leading language-learning platform connecting over 60 million learners worldwide through social learning and AI-powered courses.

Busuu offers courses in Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, and other languages, partnering with McGraw-Hill Education for content. The blog covers product updates, learning tips, efficacy research, and company milestones including its acquisition by Chegg.

## Key Topics

- Busuu platform and app
- Language learning methodology
- Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese courses
- Social learning features
- McGraw-Hill Education partnership
- Bernhard Niesner (CEO/Founder)
- Premium membership
- Efficacy studies and research
- iOS and Android apps
- Learning motivation and goal-setting
- CEFR certification
- Google Assistant integration
- Chegg acquisition
- Community of 60M+ learners

## Company News & Milestones

- [Busuu is now part of Chegg](https://blog.busuu.com/busuu-acquired-by-chegg): Bernhard Niesner announces Busuu's acquisition by edtech company Chegg
- [New Research Reinforces Busuu's Industry-Leading Efficacy](https://blog.busuu.com/2021-busuu-efficacy-study): Dr Roumen Vesselinov efficacy study validates Busuu's learning effectiveness
- [Research study shows that busuu has helped 92% of participants to learn a language](https://blog.busuu.com/open-university-research-study): Open University research confirms 92% learning effectiveness for Busuu
- [busuu turns 10 and you're in for a treat](https://blog.busuu.com/celebration-unit): Busuu's 10th anniversary celebration with special party vocabulary unit
- [Free language lessons for Ukrainians](https://blog.busuu.com/free-language-lessons-ukranians): Bernhard Niesner announces free 3-month Premium access for Ukrainians

## Product Updates & Features

- [Più vicino che mai - ai nostri 60 milioni di studenti di lingua](https://blog.busuu.com/busuu-funzionalita-sociali): New social features update for iOS and Android connecting 60M users
- [Más interacción que nunca con nuestros 60 millones de usuarios](https://blog.busuu.com/es/busuu-funcionalidades-sociales): Social features update enabling interaction among 60M users (Spanish)
- [您现在可以利用法语通过 Google 智能助理使用 busuu 博树 - 即将支持德语](https://blog.busuu.com/google-assistant-2): Google Assistant integration for French and German language learning
- [Neue Kurse: Starte mit deinem Italienisch und Portugiesisch durch!](https://blog.busuu.com/italian-portuguese-5): Launch of new Italian and Portuguese courses with McGraw-Hill Education
- [Cosa c'è di nuovo nel corso di italiano?](https://blog.busuu.com/italian-updates-4): Italian course updates with McGraw-Hill: placement tests and certificates

## Language Learning Guides

- [French Pronunciation | Top Tips from an Expert](https://blog.busuu.com/french-pronunciation): Expert guide to French pronunciation with audio and positioning tips
- [How long does it take to learn Spanish?](https://blog.busuu.com/how-long-does-it-take-to-learn-spanish): Guide to Spanish learning timeline and factors affecting fluency
- [Romance Language: The Truth Behind the Name](https://blog.busuu.com/romance-languages): Explaining Romance languages origins and their Latin roots
- [Say You're Vegetarian Or Vegan in Italian & Other Languages](https://blog.busuu.com/how-to-say-vegetarian-vegan-different-languages): Veganuary guide: dietary phrases in Italian, Spanish, Portuguese
- [Твой гид по английской футбольной лексике](https://blog.busuu.com/%d1%82%d0%b2%d0%be%d0%b9-%d0%b3%d0%b8%d0%b4-%d0%bf%d0%be-%d0%b0%d0%bd%d0%b3%d0%bb%d0%b8%d0%b9%d1%81%d0%ba%d0%be%d0%b9-%d1%84%d1%83%d1%82%d0%b1%d0%be%d0%bb%d1%8c%d0%bd%d0%be%d0%b9-%d0%bb%d0%b5%d0%ba): Guide to English football vocabulary and slang in Russian
